style: Art style: polished Japanese anime feature-film illustration, clean confident linework, detailed faces and hands, cinematic low-key lighting, cold blue night tones against warm amber neon, wet reflective Tokyo rain where relevant, desaturated ink-black palette with brass-gold (#c4a46c) highlights and vermilion red (#b8432d) accents, subtle film grain and ink-wash edges. Not photorealistic, not 3D render. No watermark, no signature, no logo.

groupStyles.model-sheet: Asset: character model sheet for a comic production. Plain warm-grey paper background. Show the SAME character three times side by side at equal scale: front view, three-quarter view, back view, full body, neutral standing pose, plus one small head close-up with a typical expression in the top-right corner. Absolutely no text, labels or captions.
groupStyles.comic: Asset: one full Chinese manhua page, vertical 2:3. White page margins and thin white gutters between panels. Read top-to-bottom, left-to-right. Dialogue in clean white rounded speech balloons with crisp black Simplified Chinese text copied EXACTLY as given (do not add, drop or alter any character); narration in white rectangular caption boxes. Keep every character's design identical to the reference model sheets (hair, eyes, outfit, props). Keep lettering large and legible; no other text, no sound effects in English, no page numbers.
groupStyles.portrait: Asset: square character portrait for a story dossier. Half-body, character centered, facing slightly toward camera, expressive face. Dark ink-wash background with a faint brass-gold circular dragon motif, soft rim light. No text.
groupStyles.key: Asset: vertical character key art for a role-selection screen. Full body or three-quarter body, dramatic pose that expresses personality, set in a characteristic Tokyo location, strong silhouette, generous dark negative space at the top and bottom for UI overlay. No text.
groupStyles.scene: Asset: wide establishing background plate for a visual novel, 3:2. No people in the foreground (distant silhouettes allowed), strong depth and atmosphere, composition leaves the lower third calmer for text overlay. No text, no signage with readable letters.
groupStyles.ending: Asset: wide cinematic ending illustration for a visual novel, 3:2, emotionally resolved composition, generous negative space. No text.
groupStyles.cover: Asset: book-cover key visual for an interactive novel. Iconic, poster-like composition with generous dark negative space for a title overlay. No text, no title, no letters.
groupStyles.ui: Asset: seamless background texture for a UI. Subtle, low contrast, no objects, no text.

jobs.prompt: Character: Lu Mingfei, 18-year-old Chinese male student, messy short black hair, slim build, plain but gentle face, slightly tired self-deprecating eyes. Outfit: navy-blue hooded zip jacket damp from rain, grey T-shirt, black trousers, white sneakers. Match the face and outfit of the reference portrait.

Character: Uesugi Erii, 17-year-old girl, waist-length straight dark crimson hair, rose-red eyes, a white ribbon tying a side lock. Show TWO outfits: the left half shows her home outfit (white kimono top with red hakama, red cord knots), the right half shows her runaway outfit (simple white dress with a short beige jacket). She holds a small notebook and pen in both. Calm, quiet expression. Match the face of the reference portrait.

Character: Gen Chisei (Minamoto Chisei), 24-year-old Japanese man, short black hair swept back, stern handsome face with tired eyes. Outfit: black suit, black shirt, long black coat with dark red lining, small family crest pin on left lapel. Match the reference portrait.

Character: Caesar Gattuso, 20-year-old tall European man, shoulder-length golden hair, ice-blue eyes, confident bearing. Outfit: white high-collar tactical long coat, black inner shirt, black gloves, black tactical boots. Match the reference portrait.

Character: Chu Zihang, 19-year-old Chinese young man, neat black hair, calm and taciturn, sharp eyes (show the close-up with glowing molten-gold irises). Outfit: dark charcoal tactical uniform, a long katana bag slung over his back, black boots.

Character: Tachibana Masamune, Japanese man in his sixties, neatly combed grey-white hair and a trimmed short grey beard, kind grandfatherly smile that is hard to read. Outfit: dark navy haori over a grey kimono, wooden prayer beads at the wrist.

Uesugi Erii in her white dress and beige jacket stands on a rain-soaked Tokyo rooftop at night, seen from behind at three-quarter, holding her small notebook; her long crimson hair moves in the wind. Behind her, the vast neon city under a storm sky; far away a black skyscraper with a single red-lit window. Lu Mingfei stands a few steps behind her, small in frame, looking at her. A faint brass-gold dragon silhouette is hidden in the storm clouds. Keep the left 45% of the image dark and calm for a title overlay.

Vertical poster: Uesugi Erii in her white dress stands under a single transparent umbrella in a rain-soaked Tokyo alley at night, turning to look back toward the viewer, notebook held to her chest; neon reflections in puddles; above her the sky is dark with a faint brass-gold dragon silhouette in the clouds. Keep the top 35% dark and calm for a vertical title.

The same kitschy Tokyo theme-hotel suite at night: starry ceiling lights, duck-shaped lamp, dark wood walls, black stone table with a medicine case and a notebook, heavy curtains half-open to a rainy neon window.

A Tokyo theme-hotel corridor at night seen through a door left ajar: elevator doors opening at the end, long shadows of approaching men, flickering ceiling light, red exit sign glow (no readable letters).

A Tokyo shopping street at dusk with black sedans parked along the curb and black-suited searchers with earpieces scanning the crowd; tension in an otherwise ordinary scene.
A Tokyo observation deck at dawn: huge floor-to-ceiling glass, the city waking in pale gold and blue mist, Mount Fuji faint on the horizon, empty benches.
Genji Heavy Industries command floor in red alert: giant wall of surveillance screens with a city map and pulsing dots, empty long table, red emergency lighting.
A brick-walled safehouse at night: single hanging lamp over a table of maps and a satellite phone, gear cases, rain on blacked-out windows, a katana bag leaning on the wall.

An underground parking garage at night: concrete pillars, a freight elevator, an extraction van with headlights on, multiple sets of headlights approaching from different ramps, wet floor reflections.

Tragic canonical ending mood: Lu Mingfei stands alone in the rain outside Genji Heavy Industries holding Erii's yellow rubber duck and notebook, the tower's single red window above, heavy grief and resolve.

Early ending mood: Erii (white dress) sitting alone on an empty elevated train platform at night under a flickering light, notebook on her lap, a train departing into the distance.
